items.title: Actual Gaussian quadratic variances

source.anchor: S4.Thmtheorem5.p1.2; A3.SS3.p8.1/Ex148/Ex149/p8.2; standing S4 fixed-spectrum family. Ex25 variance clause is a separate private numerical application only.
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling.
source.scope: Actual diagonal quadratic variance identities/bounds; the private numerical contrast is not a claim of the full source sampling test.

items.statement: For the actual inverse-precision Gaussian, both quadratic observables are square integrable and have these exact variances and bounds. \operatorname{Var}(\|U\|^2)=2\sum_i\lambda_i^{-2}\le2M,\qquad\operatorname{Var}(Q(U))=2\sum_i\frac{\cos^2(n\theta_i)}{\lambda_i^2}\le2M\le\frac{2d}{\sqrt\kappa}. Fix \(d\in\mathbb N\), \(d\ge2\), \(\kappa\in\mathbb R\), \(\kappa\ge2\), and \(n\in\mathbb N\) with \(1\le n<d\). Set \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(\lambda_i=(\kappa+1)/2+((\kappa-1)/2)\cos\theta_i\), and \(\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_i)\). Lean indexes by \(i\in\mathrm{Fin}\,d\), using \((i.\mathrm{val}+1/2)\pi/d\). Let \(U\sim N(0,\Lambda^{-1})\) in standard real Euclidean space, \(Q(x)=\sum_i\cos(n\theta_i)x_i^2\), and \(M=\mathbb E\|U\|^2\). The Gaussian matrix argument is covariance; \(\Lambda\) is precision. Coordinate independence, fourth moments, all square integrability, positivity and inverse identities are proved internally. Real variance is the standard centered second moment, with the displayed square integrability conclusions excluding its infinite-variance default-zero convention.
assumptions: Fix \(d\in\mathbb N\), \(d\ge2\), \(\kappa\in\mathbb R\), \(\kappa\ge2\), and \(n\in\mathbb N\) with \(1\le n<d\).

Set \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(\lambda_i=(\kappa+1)/2+((\kappa-1)/2)\cos\theta_i\), and \(\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_i)\). Lean indexes by \(i\in\mathrm{Fin}\,d\), using \((i.\mathrm{val}+1/2)\pi/d\).

Let \(U\sim N(0,\Lambda^{-1})\) in standard real Euclidean space, \(Q(x)=\sum_i\cos(n\theta_i)x_i^2\), and \(M=\mathbb E\|U\|^2\). The Gaussian matrix argument is covariance; \(\Lambda\) is precision.

Coordinate independence, fourth moments, all square integrability, positivity and inverse identities are proved internally. Real variance is the standard centered second moment, with the displayed square integrability conclusions excluding its infinite-variance default-zero convention.

obligations.label: Both actual quadratic observables belong to L2.
Both exact finite variance sums hold for the literal Gaussian.
Both variances≤2M and2M≤2d/sqrtκ, with M the actual integral.

bindings.boundary: Only actual diagonal-Gaussian norm/Q L2, exact variances, both2M bounds, the closed-mean dimension bound and a private non-Anchor numeric contrast variance application are claimed. The private tau assumptions are not public source hypotheses or proved source threshold conditions. Full Lemma4.5, exponential bias/log estimates, actual orthogonal target-law transport, Krylov/concentration/adaptive/private-seed/history/output laws, exact oracle/TV precision/deterministic worst-case query caps/explicit expected-cost adapters and both main lower bounds remain open. Independent sourceV, serialized latest-main integration, desktop/mobile/source-index/graph acceptance, remote publication, purification and Exposition Seal are separate.
